feeding_claim.verbatim: Our beef is 100% Grass-fed and Grass-finished.

pickup_locations: Local pickup in Manhattan, KS (ground beef bundles)
Simon Meat Locker (processor), 100 Industrial Drive, Olsburg, KS (whole beef, lamb and hog)

notes: Run by Heath and Kari on Kari's family farm (in the family since 1973). The site never names the farm's town, only 'Northeast Kansas', so city is a placeholder; pickup is in Manhattan and processing in Olsburg, so the farm is likely in the Manhattan area; confirm before publishing. Read the about page, shop, contact, the beef, pork and lamb reservation pages, the ground beef bundle page and the grass-fed beef blog page (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote). About page: 'we provide grass-fed and grass-finished beef and lamb, and pastured pork' with rotational grazing. Pork page says '100% pasture raised pork' but does not say what the pigs eat; lamb page says pasture-raised Saint Croix sheep with no diet details. Beef reservation $500 at $5.75/lb hanging weight (quarters priced as an example); whole hog $3.00/lb and half hog $3.50/lb hanging weight; whole lamb $8.00/lb. Ground beef bundle (10 x 1 lb, $79.50) shown out of stock. No shipping or delivery. Email info@prairietoforkfarm.com. Site also mentions plans for pastured poultry and sells fencing and water supplies.
